promptLatex: Points $A$, $B$, $C$, and $D$ lie on a circle, with $C$ and $D$ both lying on the same arc running from $A$ to $B$. If $\angle ACB = 37^{\circ}$, what is the measure of $\angle ADB$, in degrees?
hintLatex: Two inscribed angles on the same chord, from the same side of it, are equal.
The two angles are in the same segment, so they have the same measure.
solutionLatex:
Both $\angle ACB$ and $\angle ADB$ are inscribed angles whose two endpoints are $A$ and $B$, so each intercepts the same arc $AB$ — the one lying on the other side of the chord.

Inscribed angles standing on the same chord from the same side are equal. The two vertices $C$ and $D$ lie on the same arc, so they are on the same side of the chord.

Hence $\angle ADB = \angle ACB = 37^{\circ}$.
